canonical_identity.acyclic: Earlier root static selection/qualification -> Subject -> BootstrapPolicy -> IssuerProfile -> ConstructionPlan -> actual ParentCustody admission -> runtime BootstrapAttestation/private capability -> Seed/Binding -> three CreationCaptures -> EarlySelection -> fourth CreationCapture -> authenticated EarlyOwnerOpened. No earlier node contains a later node pin.
canonical_identity.bytes: UTF-8 JSON, exact builtin scalar types, no duplicates/nonfinite/NUL/surrogates, sorted field keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=false and exactly one trailing LF. Pin hashes those exact published bytes; no object-order projection.
canonical_identity.source_bindings: Issuer/profile/attestation qualification objects bind the same immutable bootstrap and issuer source closure plus native role policy before plan construction. They never attest a future success object.
canonical_identity.subject_keys: Exact ConstructionPlan.fields minus schema/private_issuer_profile, with its separate fixed schema; no caller-supplied include/exclude list.

causal_order: Before this H construction route begins, independently selected immutable ordinary inputs already contain EarlyConstructionSubject, EarlyIssuerBootstrapPolicy, EarlyIssuerProfile and ConstructionPlan. The static preparation follows the fixed source-owned API below under its actual prior root owner, preserving its original costs; it is not performed inside seed/interface construction or claimed free.

Static preparation: build the exact named ConstructionPlan projection excluding schema/private_issuer_profile; publish/read back EarlyConstructionSubject. The earlier root static selection and existing source/native qualification subjects predate it and contain no future outcomes.

Build EarlyIssuerBootstrapPolicy selecting that subject and exact bootstrap/issuer/admission source and original finite bounds. Build EarlyIssuerProfile selecting the subject and policy with identical source/qualification/bounds/capture-root fields. Neither contains actual H PID, runtime attestation, future ConstructionPlan, EarlySelection, seals, census or outcomes.

Build ConstructionPlan with private_issuer_profile equal that completed profile and every remaining named field exactly equal its earlier subject. This immutable plan is independently selected before the first H seed/interface construction effect; selected_before_first_effect retains its original meaning.

Existing independently qualified root bootstrap establishes actual ParentCustody and RootBootstrapAdmission with original Share/process/start/clock/row/raw-error custody. H boundedly reads/authenticates the preexisting static chain under that same parent Share. Missing exact root capability or selected plan refuses before new construction; JSON cannot instantiate either private owner.

The fixed bootstrap now publishes EarlyIssuerBootstrapAttestation from the actual root admission and actual ParentCustody, pinning earlier profile/policy/subject plus actual H identity/clock/row/custody/nonce. This runtime attestation is not an input to its own earlier profile or plan. It creates the one private EarlyIssuerCapability by live identity and is charged before seed attachment.

Existing attach_seed_capture_v2 uses the same original ParentCustody and already selected plan. EarlyResources.attach_seed_v2 lines141-146 places its entire earlier spent prefix into host and refuses if protected terminal capacity was used. Original active clocks/spans and errors persist.
Actual EarlyConstruction produces interface, ABI and paired-view manifest in order with three actual complete CreationResult handles.

RootPrecommitIssuer.issue_v2 consumes the private capability once, validates runtime attestation/profile/policy/subject/plan/owner and the three exact result/capture identities, builds unchanged EarlySelection-v2 and invokes the fixed fourth create_capture_v2 operation.

EarlySelectionAdmission.authenticate_open_v1 accepts only that actual issuance handle and completed fourth capture. Bounded read/parse and full exact field/live-owner authentication precede the once-only SelectionReadState transition and completed EarlyOwnerOpened-v2 publication.
failure: Before actual selection authentication, every failure uses the unchanged PreselectionFailurePrefix with selection=null. Published selection bytes without authentication remain preselection. After authentication, FailurePrefix uses that exact selection. Raw first is retained before diagnostics/cost/clock/close; failed capture has no invented Pin; failed auth cannot retry issuance/open or renew nonce. Parent remains alive with original unresolved handles/costs even if wire failure publication fails.

original_field_mapping.EarlyOwnerOpened: Same selection and fourth capture, original seed/binding/source/host/nonce; initial_observed records actual carried prefix, never a newly reset counter.
original_field_mapping.EarlySelection: All original fields remain exact: agent_policy/development_profile/scientific_template/source_admission from actual plan; interface/ABI/paired_views and creation_captures from the three completed creators; early_owner_binding from actual bootstrap; clock/host_identity/reservation/hard_envelope/campaign/schedule/host+arm shares from the actual earlier admitted root owner and plan.
original_field_mapping.qualification: Exactly the preselected issuer source/native admission subject carried in EarlyIssuerProfile, joined to its independent root bootstrap handle; not a newly claimed scientific qualification.

private_handles.EarlyIssuerCapability: Constructed only by fixed H bootstrap after actual independent RootBootstrapAdmission, selected static chain and ParentCustody; carries the actual parent object, profile/subject/runtime attestation, source owner, nonce and one-use state. No dict/Pin/boolean grants it.
private_handles.EarlySelectionAdmission: Actual same-owner accepted issuer handle + complete capture + source-owned field equality; serialization or existence of a root-owned file alone is insufficient.
private_handles.IssuanceHandle: Created before the first issuance effect, attached to the same original parent, contains attempted state, raw primary/secondaries, actual result and optional completed output/capture pins. Consumed once, including failed issuance.

programme_output_current_composition.prior_text: V1 operative bodies and the full final peer are immutable history, not competing current clauses.
programme_output_current_composition.wire_continuity: Original102 and all12 ProgrammeOutputV1 record bodies plus ProgrammeArgument remain exactly unchanged. ProgrammeOutputV2 adds DevelopmentWorkspaceClosure, HStreamSideV1 and HStreamCaptureV1 plus exact existing CostPrefix/clock/owner/caller relations. Existing schema literals are not a version fallback.

programme_output_v2.future_records: Source manifests/receipts/seals/assembly/final census are later products and cannot appear in ABI or their own prior static subjects.
programme_output_v2.no_future_prerequisite: Static ABI/policy and original preparation/launch continue using their existing earlier owner and original H E. New closure/capture records appear only after actual lifecycle closure; none becomes a prerequisite for the earlier issuer or a source of E.
programme_output_v2.original_identity: All original subject/policy/profile/plan/seed/binding/selection identity rules persist. New ABI source pins must be positively admitted in the same complete ordinary source closure; no generic manifest author or model may supply a callback.
programme_output_v2.static_input: New ABI exact body is selected as AgentPolicy.programme_capture_ABI by the earlier original static owner, before AgentPolicy hash/subject/plan/issuer. ABI carries only implementation source/dispatch and literal closed grammar/cap-rule identity; no future policy/selection/capture reference.

remaining_prerequisites: Actual earlier RootBootstrapAdmission and native/source authority remain required. The static preparation API uses its actual pre-existing prior root owner; this document does not create that owner. H missing its exact independently selected static chain or actual runtime bootstrap capability refuses before seed/interface construction. No JSON record creates an accepted capability.

source_owners.bootstrap: Prospective fixed root_bootstrap.bind_early_issuer_v1; runs in actual earlier H bootstrap with the already admitted ParentCustody and independently issued RootBootstrapAdmission private handle.
source_owners.consumer: Prospective EarlySelectionAdmission.authenticate_open_v1; separate once-only consumer of the actual issuer return and completed fourth CreationResult.
source_owners.issuer: Prospective fixed RootPrecommitIssuer class; no injectable callback, wire capability, participant-selected issuer, signing key or network service.
source_owners.static_preparation: Prospective fixed prepare_static_issuer_inputs_v1(actual prior root owner, exact predeclared configuration/source selection): bounded metadata capture/publication under original earlier root budget, before H task construction. It returns exact subject/policy/profile/plan handles and pins, never runtime H identity or source/native qualification.

static_vs_runtime_costs: Static source preparation uses its actual separately existing prior root owner and is never attributed as zero H work; original preparation evidence/costs remain with that selected ancestor. All H reads/authentication/runtime-attestation/publication and subsequent seed/issuer work use the actual original H parent Share and carried host prefix. An unavailable prior root owner/qualification remains refusal, never a fabricated payer.
v3_later_contract_identity: After its actual authenticate_open_v1 return, PREPARATION_CONTRACT.contract_identity_v3 consumes that same owner/open/selection/binding. Earlier static/runtime issuer chain, four creations, costs and source semantics are unchanged.
